senses.definition: A person employed to drive a private motor car or a hired car of executive or luxury class (like a limousine).

quotes.text: He fell into a reverie, a most dangerous state of mind for a chauffeur, since a fall into reverie on the part of a driver may mean a fall into a ravine on the part of the machine.
quotes.reference: 1913, Robert Barr, chapter 3, in Lord Stranleigh Abroad:

quotes.text:
Super Nintendo, Sega Genesis
When I was dead broke, man, I couldn't picture this
50-inch screen, money-green leather sofa
Got two rides, a limousine with a chauffeur
quotes.reference: 1994, 2:40 from the start, in Juicy (Hip Hop), spoken by The Notorious B.I.G.:

quotes.text: I can make money from the comfort of my sofa / So much drive, now I gotta get a chauffeur
quotes.reference: 2024, “Hot One”, in King of the Mischievous South Vol. 2, performed by Denzel Curry:

senses.definition: (firefighting) The driver of a fire truck.
(intransitive) To be, or act as, a chauffeur (driver of a motor car).

quotes.text: "Old Pearson. He did gardening for us, and chauffeuring for my father. Such a dear old man - I've know him all my life."
quotes.reference: 1951, John Wyndham, The Day of the Triffids, Harmondsworth: Penguin Books, published 1954, page 75:

senses.definition: (transitive) To transport (someone) in a motor vehicle.
